mapper.sql: select id, trade_date, stock_code, stock_name, market_type, latest_price, change_percent, total_amount, main_net_inflow, main_inflow_ratio, super_large_inflow, super_large_ratio, large_inflow, large_ratio, medium_inflow, medium_ratio, small_inflow, small_ratio, data_timestamp, created_at, updated_at from stock_fund_flow
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(id) AS id, MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date, stock_code, MAX(stock_name) AS stock_name, MAX(market_type) AS market_type, (SELECT latest_price FROM stock_fund_flow t2 WHERE t2.stock_code = stock_fund_flow.stock_code ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_price, (EXP(SUM(LN(1 + change_percent / 100))) - 1) * 100 AS change_percent, SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount, SUM(main_net_inflow) AS main_net_inflow, CASE WHEN SUM(total_amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(main_net_inflow) / SUM(total_amount)) * 100 END AS main_inflow_ratio, SUM(super_large_inflow) AS super_large_inflow, CASE WHEN SUM(total_amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(super_large_inflow) / SUM(total_amount)) * 100 END AS super_large_ratio, SUM(large_inflow) AS large_inflow, CASE WHEN SUM(total_amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(large_inflow) / SUM(total_amount)) * 100 END AS large_ratio, SUM(medium_inflow) AS medium_inflow, CASE WHEN SUM(total_amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(medium_inflow) / SUM(total_amount)) * 100 END AS medium_ratio, SUM(small_inflow) AS small_inflow, CASE WHEN SUM(total_amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(small_inflow) / SUM(total_amount)) * 100 END AS small_ratio FROM stock_fund_flow WHERE trade_date IN ( SELECT trade_date FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT trade_date FROM stock_fund_flow ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT #{rankDays} ) AS recent_dates ) AND stock_code = #{stockCode} AND stock_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{stockName}, '%') GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY main_net_inflow DESC

WITH LatestDate AS ( SELECT MAX(trade_date) as latest_date FROM stock_fund_flow ) SELECT stock_code AS stockCode, stock_name AS stockName, (super_large_inflow + large_inflow) AS largeNet, (medium_inflow + small_inflow) AS smallNet, (ABS(super_large_inflow + large_inflow) + ABS(medium_inflow + small_inflow)) AS divergence FROM stock_fund_flow WHERE trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM LatestDate) AND (super_large_inflow + large_inflow) > 0 AND (medium_inflow + small_inflow) < 0 ORDER BY divergence DESC LIMIT 10

WITH LatestDate AS ( SELECT MAX(trade_date) as latest_date FROM stock_fund_flow ) SELECT stock_code AS stockCode, stock_name AS stockName, (super_large_inflow + large_inflow) AS largeNet, (medium_inflow + small_inflow) AS smallNet, (ABS(super_large_inflow + large_inflow) + ABS(medium_inflow + small_inflow)) AS divergence FROM stock_fund_flow WHERE trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM LatestDate) AND (super_large_inflow + large_inflow) < 0 AND (medium_inflow + small_inflow) > 0 ORDER BY divergence DESC LIMIT 10

WITH RecentDates AS ( SELECT DISTINCT trade_date FROM stock_fund_flow ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT #{rankDays} ), DailyRankings AS ( SELECT trade_date, stock_code, stock_name, main_net_inflow, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY trade_date ORDER BY main_net_inflow DESC) as rn FROM stock_fund_flow WHERE trade_date IN (SELECT trade_date FROM RecentDates) ) SELECT stock_code AS stockCode, stock_name AS stockName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM DailyRankings WHERE rn <= 10 GROUP BY stock_code, stock_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
